title: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
ai_summary:

• The regulation is set to be implemented by the end of 2024, with compliance required from all relevant parties.
student_angle: None, but be aware of AI and security regulations as you'll encounter them in real-world tech applications.

title: Postgres rewritten in Rust, now passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests
ai_summary:
• Postgres rewritten in Rust has achieved 100% of Postgres regression tests, marking significant progress in database technology.
• The project demonstrates Rust's potential as a viable alternative for database programming languages, outperforming C and C++.
• This achievement highlights the collaborative efforts between Rust and Postgres communities, driving innovation in open-source technology.
student_angle: Learn Rust if you're interested in database engineering and want to contribute to an exciting project, expanding your skill set.

title: Focus
ai_summary:

ai_summary:

title: Don’t want to invest in Elon Musk? Two new ETFs explicitly exclude him
ai_summary:

• The exclusion means SpaceX and Tesla shares are not included in the ETFs, affecting investors' diversification.
